decisions.reason: As a sheet preparation module that builds on the firm's established modular finishing offer and remains on its own webpage in 2024, it fits the announced automation direction and has enough visible commitment behind it that management would likely continue it unless clear failure became undeniable.

This folding add-on unit is close to the core business, is still shown in 2024, and can be justified by a named customer application, so under escalation of commitment management would be inclined to keep it on the market rather than admit an unsuccessful launch.
